requirements.general: Passed in the Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia (SPM) / Sijil Pelajaran Malaysia Vocational (SPMV) exam by obtaining at least 3 credits in any subject including one of the Islamic Religion subjects and passing the Arabic language subject OR Passed Thanawi Certificate 4 with 3 subjects and got the rank of Jayyid or equivalent recognized by the Government or University Senate and passed Bahasa Malaysia at SPM / SPMV level OR Other qualifications recognized as equivalent by the Malaysian government. International students IGCSE O-Level or equivalent with minimum 3 subjects with grade "C" or better
